div.head: Swer 7
div.ab: Að gif man afindeð his æhtc, syððan he hit geboht hafeð, unhal. On ealmihtiges Godes naman, ðu me behete hal 7 clæne þæt, ðæt ðu me sealdest, 7 fulle ware wið æfterspræce, on ða gewitnesse, ðe unc ða mid wæs: N.
Per omnipotentis Dei nomen, tu mihi promisisti sanum et mundum, quod mihi uendidisti, et plenam defensionem contra omnem postlocutionem, in eo testimonio, quod tunc nobiscum affuit, N.
On ælmihtiges Godes naman, ðu me behete hal 7 clæne þæt, þæt ðu me sealdest, 7 fulle ware wið æfterspræce, on ða gewitennesse, ðe unc ða mid wæs: N.
[I swear] in the name of Almighty God [that] you vowed that [the sale] was honest and true, and what you sold me was proof against future claims as was witnessed [by another] in our presence: N.

(Eid [des Klägers], wenn jemand sein Werthstück, nachdem er es gekauft hat, als fehlbehaftet erkennt. B) Im Namen des allmächtigen Gottes, du hast mir das, was du mir verkauftest, heil und [von Anfechtung] rein versprochen und volle Gewähr gegen [dessen] zukünftige Einklagung, unter der Zeugenschaft, die da [beim Kaufe] bei uns beiden war: N.

(The oath [of the plaintiff] when someone, after buying his goods, finds them faulty. B) In the name of almighty God, you promised me that what you sold me was sound and clean [of any claim], and full warranty against any future claim [on it], in the witness that was then with us both [at the sale]: N.
div.note: Liebermann compares Ine 56. K: a stray space before a comma removed.
